definitions: A Dual Active Bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter is a type of power electronic converter used to transfer power between two DC voltage levels, often with galvanic isolation, known for its high efficiency and bidirectional power flow capability.
examples: The DAB dc-dc converter is crucial for battery charging applications.
Researchers are optimizing the control strategies for the DAB dc-dc converter.
The efficiency of the DAB dc-dc converter was measured at various load conditions.
